name: GREAT-IGEV
plain: IGEV-Stereo extended with global attention (spatial, epipolar-row and volume attention).
summary: GREAT-IGEV (Li et al. 2025): IGEV-Stereo with global attention (spatial, epipolar-row matching and volume attention) that builds an excitation-weighted cost volume, then IGEV's ConvGRU updates, 32 iterations.

papers.title: Global Regulation and Excitation via Attention Tuning for Stereo Matching

task_io: Input: a rectified left / right image pair. Output: a disparity map (pixels, left view).
